# Pull request

## Summary

What this change does and why.

## Type of change

- [ ] Editorial (clarification only, no model change) - patch
- [ ] Model change (new or changed fields/entities) - minor
- [ ] Tooling / CI / docs

## Checklist

- [ ] Specification, JSON Schema and examples are in sync
- [ ] `npm run check` passes locally (markdownlint + schema validation)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated (for any model change)
- [ ] All commits are signed off (DCO): `git commit -s`

Closes #
